verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success, professional employment history, or professional skill accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

operational-specificity-faster-general.title: Providing specific operational or inventory details predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
operational-specificity-faster-general.body: Pitches that include precise details about inventory items or operational data, rather than general categories, fund faster for both men and women.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Female borrowers who include loan amounts in local currency fund more slowly.
female-local-currency-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount in the local currency of their country are associated with slower funding speeds.

business-longevity-faster-general.title: Specifying the number of years a business or trade has been operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-longevity-faster-general.body: Pitches that explicitly state the duration of the borrower's professional experience or business operation are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-institutional-affiliations-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific institutional roles or histories may fund faster.

female-geographic-location-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention a specific geographic location in their pitch may fund more slowly.

female-repayment-promise-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly claim they will be able to repay the loan may fund more slowly.

female-partner-employment-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the employment of a partner may fund faster.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who include explicit thank-you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.

male-credit-history-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention credit history or repeat borrower status may fund more slowly.

male-children-count-slower.body: Male borrowers who specify the number of children they have may fund more slowly.

male-gratitude-faster.body: Male borrowers who include explicit gratitude markers toward lenders may fund faster.

female-family-details-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize family and household details may fund more slowly.

male-work-ethic-faster.body: Male borrowers who describe their work ethic using words like 'hardworking' or 'perseverance' may fund faster.

female-inventory-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed inventories of specific products to be purchased may fund more slowly.

female-new-venture-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe transitioning to a new business venture may fund faster.

female-children-count-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the number of children may fund more slowly.
female-children-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying children in school accelerates funding.

female-institutional-affiliations-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific institutional affiliations or training programs may fund more slowly.
female-institutional-affiliations-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that detailed descriptions of the BRAC program accelerate funding.

male-family-details-faster.title: Male borrowers who include specific details about family members, such as ages or spouse's job, may fund faster.
male-family-details-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specifying number of children slows funding for men.

female-specific-program-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe participation in specific microfinance programs like BRAC may fund faster.

female-children-education-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children currently in school may fund faster.

female-single-mother-faster.title: Female borrowers who identify as single or separated mothers may fund faster.
female-single-mother-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that family and household details correlate with slower funding for women.

female-employment-creation-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention creating employment or earning opportunities for young people may fund faster.
female-employment-creation-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to maintain puzzle cap.

female-educational-background-slower.title: Female borrowers who include specific details about their educational background may fund more slowly.
female-educational-background-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific institutional roles/histories accelerate funding for women.
